name: jennysans
description: JennySans (제니산스) — general-purpose Korean & English (Latin) sans-serif font family under SIL OFL 1.1. All 11,172 modern Hangul syllables, complete Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A (30 verified languages incl. Spanish, French, German, Polish, Czech, Turkish, Nordic and Baltic), full basic Cyrillic (Russian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian, Serbian, Macedonian) and Greek, plus KS X 1001 Korean document symbols. 9 static weights + variable font; web fonts (WOFF2 full + unicode-range subsets) and ready-made CSS. Font version 1.001 (adds ballot boxes ☐☑☒); Hanja (KS X 1001) and Vietnamese planned for 1.100.
author: JennySoft (https://jennysoft.co.kr)
